name: Exage 400LX triple crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 763 g for the exact unsuffixed FC-M400, 170 mm and 48/38/28T, excluding the separately listed bottom-bracket set. The later -SG model code is retained separately; no equivalence is asserted. The table identifies Biopace SG rings.
